prompt: Who parachuted off the 267 m high (876-ft) New River Gorge Bridge near Fayetteville, West Virginia, USA, on 19 October 2013, at the age of 84 years and 37 days?
answer: Donald Cripps parachuted off the New River Gorge Bridge on 19 October 2013 at age 84 years and 37 days.
